decision_scope: Not qualified under the current evaluation contract. This is not proof that the authors have no finer annotations, nor rejection for every research purpose.

source.name: Water Pump Dataset for a Water Supply System
source.domain: Real university water supply pumps and tanks, including potable and non-potable systems. Hydraulic/equipment monitoring, not chemical water-quality fault discrimination.

inventory.large_download_action: None; current disk budget and absent frozen protocol preclude acquisition in this task

schema_from_previously_read_documentatio.pressure: Pressure; bar; six separate incoming/outgoing pump CSVs
schema_from_previously_read_documentatio.vibration: Speed (mm/s), Displacement (micrometres), Temperature (degrees Celsius), separated by pump/axis
schema_from_previously_read_documentatio.electrical: Power P1/P2/P3 (W), Current I1/I2/I3 (A), cumulative Energy Em1/Em2/Em3 (kWh)

source.cadence_scope: Sensor aggregation only; does not establish label resolution.
source.upstream_processing: Publisher describes per-minute mean level, pressure, vibration, power and current; energy is cumulative. Minute boundary convention, original sample timing and upstream gap handling are unverified.

machine_readable_minute_labels.evidence: Current official API lists 48 named sensor CSV files and one Markdown document. No separate annotation/label/event file is listed. Previously disclosed schema describes Time and sensor measurements, not a label field.
machine_readable_minute_labels.limits: No CSV header or row was requested. File names and documented schemas alone cannot rule out undocumented content.

precise_incident_onset_and_end.evidence: The already exposed beginning of the publisher Additional Information table gives calendar dates/date ranges. No authoritative minute/second start/end annotation source was identified in the inspected metadata.
precise_incident_onset_and_end.limits: The remainder of the event table was not read. Day-only timing is established for the exposed snippet, not asserted for every possible annotation.

explicit_known_normal_coverage.evidence: The inspected public metadata and previously read schema do not establish exhaustive normal intervals or a rule that all unlisted times are normal.
explicit_known_normal_coverage.consequence: Do not turn the complement of a maintenance/fault diary into negative labels. False-positive exposure and counts are not defensible until normal coverage is documented.

event_semantics.evidence: Publisher describes three event/fault types; the previously exposed snippet includes tank-washing maintenance and a PLC/pump-trigger hardware fault.
event_semantics.consequence: These are hydraulic/equipment-operation annotations, not established chemical water-quality contamination labels; maintenance must remain a separate semantic category.

current_gate_assessment.reason: Minute-averaged observations do not supply minute-resolved event onset, and missing event records do not establish normality.

one_useful_next_step.action: Obtain an official public annotation-and-coverage specification from the data owners before acquiring observations or preregistering a fresh test.
minimum_metadata_deliverable: Machine-readable schema for incident start/end timestamps with timezone and timing uncertainty
Event taxonomy separating maintenance, operating changes and faults
Explicit intervals of verified normal coverage and unobserved/unknown status
Clock alignment and per-minute aggregation boundary convention
one_useful_next_step.success_criterion: A documented timestamp/coverage contract supports the target delay and false-alarm semantics without inferring truth from sensor values.
one_useful_next_step.future_acquisition_and_protocol: Only after qualification; keep published date exposure in any preregistration and disclose the hydraulic-domain scope.

evidence_chain.checksum_limit: Publisher inventory checksum equality supports unchanged documentation identity; this follow-up did not download and independently hash the complete README.
evidence_chain.search_scope: Exact dataset/record and label/annotation/normal terms; no broad new-source loop.
evidence_chain.paper_access: Publisher DOI returned HTTP403. The institution index confirms the paper and offers a PDF; the PDF was not opened or downloaded to avoid plots/incident-detail exposure.
evidence_chain.readme_prefix_attempt: A bounded streaming prefix request intended to stop before Additional Information failed TLS certificate verification before content. No certificate verification bypass was attempted; existing documented schema plus current publisher MD5 were used.

prior_exposure_preserved.action: Open university pump13.5kB publisher description with web tool
prior_exposure_preserved.exposed_scope: Web response automatically included description lines0–245: schema/cadence plus the beginning of Additional Information table, lines244–245. This revealed the tank-washing date span2023-08-31 through2023-09-06 and a list of calendar dates for PLC-trigger faults in August–October2023. No later table rows were requested or inspected. No measurement CSV or annotation array was opened.
prior_exposure_preserved.action_after_discovery: Stopped document inspection and immediately disclosed exposure to root. This source is NOT described as wholly label-unseen; no model parameters, thresholds, cohort selection or trials were derived from these dates.
prior_exposure_preserved.scope_of_no_rows_claim: No measured observations or row-label arrays; the published event-schedule snippet above was exposed and is explicitly excluded from any zero-label-exposure assertion.

exposure_log.this_followup: Read official record/file inventory/license/checksums, institution publication title/authors/DOI, and limited search snippets. Re-read the prior local review. No additional incident dates, measured observations, row annotation arrays, plots or model contents were opened.
exposure_log.why_not_wholly_unseen: The prior published calendar-day schedule snippet was exposed, even though no measured row or row-label array has been read.

workspace_scope.download_accounting: Direct API body was 19,416 bytes. Web metadata page transport bytes are not exposed by the web tool. No large/data/PDF download was requested.
